mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive more than 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive more than 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.2 million units per month signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.2 million and 5-day forward returns are negative more than 45% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and 20-day forward returns are positive more than 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive more than 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and 20-day forward returns are negative more than 45% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 3% year-over-year signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY > 3% and 5-day forward returns are negative more than 45% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and UNRATE > 5% and 20-day forward returns are positive more than 60% of the time.
